style.name: Belgian Mediterranean
style.definition: Relaxed Belgian linen and weathered wood warmed with Mediterranean clay and pale stone.
style.materials: flax linen; weathered oak; limestone; terracotta; woven rush
style.living: flax slipcovered sofa; weathered-oak rush armchair; oval limestone coffee table; weathered-oak media cabinet; rectangular oak table and four rush-seat chairs; oversized flax pendant
style.bed: weathered-oak queen with flax headboard; ivory linen and clay throw; oak nightstands and clay lamps
style.solarium: weathered teak outdoor sofa and chair with flax performance cushions; teak dining set and clay pots
style.implement: Make linen the dominant texture and reserve terracotta for lamps, throws and pots.
style.avoid: Avoid faux arches or replacing the fixed kitchen surfaces.
